evidence_type: User-confirmed historical account; not synthetic demo telemetry
chronology: Calvin defined segments, jobs, requirements, strategic considerations, prototype and success measures with Analytics
Analytics implemented and launched the advanced certification dashboard
Calvin investigated a post-launch dashboard usage gap and led the agent-assisted contextual-link improvement
The link was agent-built, reviewed by the QA agent in staging, reviewed by Calvin in an ephemeral environment and approved by his EM before shipping, then reviewed again by the QA agent in production
Customer engagement and program-health signals were subsequently observed

dashboard_click_through.cohort: all certification users with dashboard access

qualitative_observations: Higher-volume professional certification academies engaged more after clicking through
Recertification-enabled certification programs showed a positive trend
hypothesis: Better visibility into program health and repeat-program revenue encouraged some customers to create more recertification-enabled programs
limits: No causal isolation of the contextual link's effect on program growth
No numerical uplift for qualitative engagement or recertification trends
Historical measurement windows and cohorts differ from synthetic exposed-admin comparisons

prototyping_scope.advanced_analytics_dashboard: Calvin prototyped the advanced dashboard; Analytics implemented it
prototyping_scope.credential_rebuild: Calvin prototyped the certification overview, certificate designer and full flow across the initial slice and subsequent certification-at-scale slices; those slices shipped
prototyping_scope.reconstruction: The current demo reconstructs the overview and analytics-link behavior; it does not reproduce the full historical prototype

historical_placement_decision.reason: A link within a specific program could imply analytics scoped to that program, while the first dashboard covered all programs
historical_placement_decision.expectation_status: Calvin’s hypothesis based on customer mental model, not a measured expectation
historical_placement_decision.later_slice: Program-specific analytics was planned, not established as shipped
